title: Review failures and screenshots
summary: A failed assertion tells you which expected condition was not met. Use the command log and screenshot to understand it.
introduction: A failed assertion tells you which expected condition was not met. Use the command log and screenshot to understand it. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: The test verifies the heading and records visible evidence.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name a screenshot so another person can identify the page.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not hide a failure by deleting its assertion.
For more detail later, use this [Cypress further reading](https://docs.cypress.io/app/get-started/why-cypress).
